description: Mark a Chief manager task done, with a note saying what was done or decided. Only do this when the user said so in this conversation. If the task resumes a blocked milestone, resolving it re-runs that milestone, so the user is asked to confirm (needs milestones:approve).

chosen_option.description: Optional exact label from the manager task's options.

note.description: What was done or decided, shown on the task in Chief.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name. Call list_projects to find it.

name: resolve_manager_task
title: Resolve a manager task
